landmarks.label: Clift Park pier
landmarks.note: the long pier into Skaneateles Lake from Clift Park, across Genesee Street from the Sherwood Inn

landmarks.label: Sherwood Inn
landmarks.note: 1807 stagecoach tavern, blue clapboard, a long two-storey porch facing the lake

landmarks.label: Skaneateles Country Club
landmarks.note: founded 1915; the clubhouse on the lake, West Lake Street

landmarks.label: Crown Mill, Marcellus Falls
landmarks.note: the old woollen mill on Nine Mile Creek
